predictedBugs: A vendor boolean or numeric cell with an unfamiliar representation could violate the SQL typed-scalar constraint; the parser now falls back to bounded text unless conversion is deterministic.
A second preview after a create changes the plan to unchanged and could falsely trigger divergent replay; the immutable group key is now bound to the complete plan hash.
Existing contacts could skip provenance because unchanged rows previously returned early; unchanged groups now pass through the atomic sourceProfile transaction.
Workbook candidates could receive the physical title-row offset while nested source facts retained CSV-relative row numbers; both now receive the same bounded offset.
edgeCases: Empty source cells remain absent instead of creating empty facts, while all 79 populated sanitized fields are retained.
Unparseable source dates and timestamps remain text evidence rather than rejecting the contact or inventing a date.
Consent flags are preserved as typed evidence but First Class imports do not set Omnix emailSubscribed authority.
An XLSX title row before the discovered header maps both the candidate and every preserved fact to physical worksheet row 3.
